scope: Owned loopback production build. Offline HTML bytes vary by an inert revision comment, and the production worker's exact precache entry receives the matching SHA-256 revision. Real waiting/activation/cache cleanup and actual production dirty-navigation UI used in two tabs. Isolated context closed and static server stopped. Does not certify real device install/push, hosted retention of old hashed JS assets or changed-deployment rollback.

tests.name: initial production worker serves its reviewed offline asset revision
declining production worker update preserves dirty fields and waiting version
waiting changed offline asset does not replace the active version before explicit approval
approved production update reloads only the requesting dirty tab
second dirty tab keeps its fields and document across another tab's worker activation
explicit update activates the waiting worker without automatic fleet reload
approved worker activates the newly revisioned offline asset
activation removes the obsolete offline asset cache revision
multi-tab update probe performs no actual application mutation or provider send
